title: COT drives resistance to RAF inhibition through MAP kinase pathway reactivation
central_claims: COT/MAP3K8 activation drives resistance to RAF inhibitors through MAPK reactivation.
COT inhibition or combined MAPK blockade may reduce resistance.

source_manifest.title: Experiments from unfinished Registered Reports in the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology
source_manifest.finding: RAF-inhibitor resistance in high-MAP3K8 lines replicated, but COT inhibitor effects on MEK/ERK phosphorylation were opposite in direction and nonsignificant; ectopic-combination experiment incomplete.
